name: Generate SEO product and category pages

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    - cron: '17 */6 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: main-pages-write
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate static SEO pages from Firestore
        run: python3 scripts/generate_static_products.py

      - name: Commit generated SEO files
        run: |
          git config user.name 'github-actions[bot]'
          git config user.email '41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com'
          git add product product-category sitemap.xml sitemap-products.xml sitemap-categories.xml
          git rm -r --cached --ignore-unmatch category >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo 'No SEO changes.'
            exit 0
          fi
          git commit -m 'chore: regenerate SEO product and category pages'
          git pull --rebase origin main
          git push origin HEAD:main
